purpose: Exact read-only Ghidra invocations used for the two export passes, plus the Ghidra-independent verification path.

toolchain.java_home_required: Without exporting JAVA_HOME, analyzeHeadless aborts with 'Unable to locate a Java Runtime' / 'Unable to prompt user for JDK path, no TTY detected'.

safety_flags.readOnly: opens the existing project read-only; nothing is written back
safety_flags.noanalysis: no auto-analysis; only already-decoded instruction rows are exported
safety_flags.script_sha_gate: ExportSensorDiff.java refuses to run unless currentProgram.getExecutableSHA256() == 51531576fd31af96f7239b71d26e1f175815f5cb21dbe9ab305fa9a33cc6a891
safety_flags.range_targets: a start:end target dumps only already-decoded instructions in that range; it never disassembles or mutates the program
safety_flags.no_execution: no firmware executed; no device/account/API/network access

passes.name: pass1
passes.note: The 14 table callees plus a range export. 0800fd25 / 0800fd31 resolve to function=none; the range export shows 0800fd1a..0800fd44 has no decoded instructions in the retained project, which is why those two setters are decoded from raw halfwords instead.

passes.name: pass2
passes.note: The seventh init slot candidate 08012274, installed by the K36 setter. It starts with BL 08012008 and does not create a new clock config entrance.

command_template: export JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; "$HEADLESS" "$GHIDRA_PROJECT_DIR" NonUsbSensor -process firmware-sensor-g0.bbin -readOnly -noanalysis -scriptPath "$SCRIPT_DIR" -postScript ExportSensorDiff.java "$OUT_DIR" <targets...>

ghidra_independent_path.statement: All published claims can be re-verified from the retained pass1/pass2 exports plus the frozen BBIN. The Ghidra project lives in a local research directory outside the delivery and is NOT required to audit the published conclusions; it is only needed to regenerate the exports.

inputs_not_in_delivery: The NonUsbSensor.gpr project in ~/Downloads (working artifact, not part of the frozen evidence bundle)
Ghidra 12.1.4 and OpenJDK 21 installed on the analysis host
